now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3#17
now.text: Lincoln Campbell captures Gideon Malick during the raid on an oil field and wraps him in Overpowering Tape. Lincoln then helps wreck Malick's plan to bring Hive back to Earth.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Inhuman who captures Malick and helps wreck his plan for Hive.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Hydra leader Lincoln captures in the oil field raid.

proposed.text: Lincoln Campbell captures Gideon Malick when the Secret Warriors raid Hydra's base at an oil field, and wraps him in Overpowering Tape to bring him back to S.H.I.E.L.D.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Inhuman who captures Malick in the raid on Hydra's base.

changes.evidence: In S3#17 (The Team) Lincoln captures Malick at the Schoonebeek Oil Field base and binds him with Overpowering Tape. Hive has been on Earth since S3#10 (Maveth), so Lincoln does not 'wreck Malick's plan to bring Hive back to Earth' here; the stage's second sentence is a different, false event.

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3#8
now.text: Giyera serves Gideon Malick and turns on Grant Ward when Malick decides Ward is no longer useful.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Hydra leader Giyera turns on when Malick drops him.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Malick's enforcer, who turns on Ward when Malick decides Ward is no longer useful.

split.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S3#9
split.text: With Ward now working with Gideon Malick, Giyera tortures Jemma Simmons on Ward's orders until Fitz agrees to help Hydra.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Hydra leader whose orders Giyera follows in torturing Simmons.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Malick's enforcer, who tortures Simmons on Ward's orders.

changes.evidence: S3#8: Giyera leads Malick out as Malick leaves assassins for Ward, but by the episode's end Malick takes Ward into Hydra's plan for Hive. In S3#9 (Closure) Ward calls on Giyera, who tortures Simmons until Fitz agrees to help Hydra. The lone 'enemy' stage never shows that they end up on the same side.

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4
now.text: May trains Piper in hand-to-hand combat and leads the strike team she serves on under Director Jeffrey Mace. Piper stays a loyal friend through the years that follow.
now.on_a_card_about_b: An agent May trains in combat and leads on the strike team.
now.on_b_card_about_a: Piper's trainer and strike team leader under Director Mace.

proposed.text: May trains Piper in hand-to-hand combat and leads the strike team she serves on under Director Jeffrey Mace.

changes.evidence: S4#1 (The Ghost): May trains her new STRIKE team, Piper among them, under Mace. The added sentence 'Piper stays a loyal friend through the years that follow' tells of later seasons (and in S5#11 Piper turns them over to General Hale), so it goes.

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4#4
now.text: Aida, Holden Radcliffe's android, works as his assistant at S.H.I.E.L.D., where Phil Coulson is an agent.
now.on_a_card_about_b: An agent at the S.H.I.E.L.D. base where Aida assists Radcliffe.

proposed.text: Coulson meets Aida when he comes to collect May from Holden Radcliffe's home, where she is introduced as Radcliffe's assistant. He takes her for an amputee like himself.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Agent who meets Aida as Radcliffe's assistant.

split.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4#9
split.text: Aida turns on S.H.I.E.L.D. and attacks the Playground for the Darkhold. When Coulson refuses to hand it over, she knocks him out and locks him in a room.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Agent who meets Aida as Radcliffe's assistant. Aida knocks him out when she turns on S.H.I.E.L.D.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Radcliffe's android, who turns on S.H.I.E.L.D. and knocks Coulson out.

split.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4#22
split.text: Coulson borrows the Spirit of Vengeance and burns Aida, now the human Ophelia, to ashes.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Agent who meets Aida as Radcliffe's assistant, then burns her to ashes with the Spirit of Vengeance.
split.on_b_card_about_a: Radcliffe's android, who turns on S.H.I.E.L.D. Coulson burns her to ashes.

changes.evidence: S4#4 (Let Me Stand Next to Your Fire): Coulson collects May at the Radcliffe Residence, greets Aida as Radcliffe's assistant and takes her for an amputee; they are not enemies, and she does not work 'at S.H.I.E.L.D.' here. She turns on S.H.I.E.L.D. and knocks Coulson out in S4#9 (Broken Promises), and Coulson, holding the Spirit of Vengeance, burns her to ashes in S4#22 (World's End).

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4#7
now.text: The gate Aida and Holden Radcliffe build helps bring Robbie back from between dimensions.
now.on_b_card_about_a: The android whose gate helps bring Robbie back.

split.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S4#22
split.text: Back from Hell, the Ghost Rider finds Aida, now the human Ophelia, and burns her arm with his chain, a wound she cannot heal, before she teleports away.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Brought back by Aida's gate, then hunts her as the Ghost Rider.
split.on_b_card_about_a: The android whose gate helps bring Robbie back. He later wounds her with his chain.

changes.evidence: S4#7 (Deals with Our Devils): the Inter-Dimensional Gate Aida builds brings Coulson and Fitz back and Robbie returns through it, which is help, not enmity. They first clash in S4#22 (World's End), when the Ghost Rider wounds Ophelia with his chain and she teleports away.

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5#13
now.text: Agent Davis flies and fights alongside Phil Coulson, from the search for the Principia to piloting the Quinjet when Coulson goes to confront Glenn Talbot in Chicago.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Davis's director, whom he flies and fights alongside.
now.on_b_card_about_a: An agent who flies and fights alongside Coulson.

proposed.text: Agent Davis pilots Zephyr One for Phil Coulson's team in the search for the Principia, holding the plane steady while Coulson boards the floating ship.

split.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S5#22
split.text: In Chicago, Davis flies Coulson and Quake by Quinjet toward Glenn Talbot, then rushes the fainting Coulson back to Zephyr One for help.
split.on_a_card_about_b: Davis's director, whom he flies and fights alongside.
split.on_b_card_about_a: An agent who flies and fights alongside Coulson.

changes.evidence: S5#13 (Principia): Davis pilots Zephyr One to the floating Principia, which Coulson, Mack and Daisy board. The Chicago Quinjet flight is S5#22 (The End), where Coulson stays aboard and sends Quake to face Talbot alone, and Davis brings him back to Zephyr One. So that part of the stage text is a later episode.
